_comment: Every figure here is a measured run against this repo's own report at Bigquery & Dbt Cost Observability/powerbi/BigQuery dbt Cost Observability.Report, using a 16-rule map that renames the Fact table. The README documents how to reproduce it. Terminal casts reproduce that captured output verbatim except for abbreviated paths, which the caption states.

hero.name: hero
hero.title: PBIR Field Remap Toolkit
hero.subtitle: Repoint every field reference in a Power BI report from one table or column to another, driven by a CSV. Inventory first, then one command that always scans deep.

tiles.label: field bindings found across {report_files} JSON files
bookmark files only the deep scan reaches

banners.name: section-inventory
banners.title: Inventory what is actually bound
banners.body: Before you can rename anything you need the real list. One pass exports every semantic binding in the report, plus every scalar value, to CSV.

banners.name: section-remap
banners.title: Write the map, run it once
banners.body: One mode, no flags to get wrong: the deep scan always runs and the changes are always written. Every change and every reference your map did not cover is logged to CSV.

banners.name: section-reference
banners.title: Know what it does not reach
banners.body: The mapping rules, the six JSON locations it rewrites, and the places a remap silently leaves behind.
